title: Busuu language
description: Moribund Southern Bantoid language of Cameroon
extract: Busuu is an unclassified Southern Bantoid language of Cameroon. According to Ethnologue it is extinct. As of 2005, there were three speakers of the language. Busuu is an endangered language.
